test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that rectifies the error in the usage of the future tense in the given sentence.

Shivani go to school tomorrow for prize distribution.

options.text: Shivani will go to school tomorrow for prize distribution.
Shivani has gone to school tomorrow for prize distribution.
Shivani had gone to school tomorrow for prize distribution.
Shivani goes to school tomorrow for prize distribution.

solution:
The correct answer is option **1) Shivani will go to school tomorrow for prize distribution.**
